name: MIRRORLIGHT
detailed_description:
About the developer

I am a solo developer with little time and budget. With your support I can add more levels, even a level creator for the community and your wishes. Please add to your wishlist!

Unravel the Mystery in MIRRORLIGHT: A VR Puzzle Adventure

Awaken, explorer. You are lost, a stranger stranded far from your heavenly home. Your only hope lies in piecing together the shattered portal that brought you here. Embark on a captivating journey in MIRRORLIGHT, a deeply immersive VR (Virtual Reality) adventure crafted with love and care by Ghenof Interactive.

Explore a World of Light and Shadow

As a mysterious adventurer, navigate a realm consumed by darkness, where fragments of the gateway back to your homeland are scattered. Your quest is not only to recover these vital pieces but also to solve intricate light-based puzzlesthat challenge your ingenuity. Traverse stunning environments, master the art of environmental interaction, and uncover the secrets hidden within this enigmatic world.

Light-Based Combat and Captivating Challenges

Prepare for engaging puzzle solving that tests your skills and unravels cryptic clues. Encounter robotic guardians who fiercely protect the gateway fragments. Employ your mastery of light in strategic light-based combat to overcome these metallic foes. Free the imprisoned creatures who can aid you in your journey and restore balance to this fractured reality.

Restore the Gateway, Return Home in VR

MIRRORLIGHT offers a compelling blend of world exploration, strategic combat, and mind-bending puzzles. Recover the fragments, restore the gateway, and find your way back home in this immersive VR puzzle adventure. Do you have what it takes to escape the darkness?

short_description: Mirrorlight is an indie first-person VR puzzle game. Use mirrors, splitters, gemstones, and other tools to solve challenges, overcome enemies, and recover the fragments of your gateway back home! Do you have what it takes?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core2Quad Q6600 2,40 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 650 (1024 MB Ram)
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • VR Support: Requires OpenXR-compatible headset and controllers.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core I5-4440 3,10 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 660 (2048 MB Ram)
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • VR Support: Requires OpenXR-compatible headset and controllers.
